outcome: A learner estimates a polynomial's derivative from sampled values, compares forward/backward/central slopes with the exact analytic derivative, and studies six exact refinement levels through an original course and direct-open lab.
preserve: All existing learner/importer/model/courses/Newton134/interpolation172/quadrature179/diffusion197/numerical-precision source, dependencies, README and workflows remain unchanged.

model.coefficients: Exactly six dense integer Number coefficients c0..c5 in [-9,9]; reject booleans,strings,nonfinite,holes and extra object keys.
model.arithmetic: BigInt reduced rationals with positive denominators; every mathematical output exposes numerator/denominator strings and exact fraction; Number approximations are display-only.
model.report: Immutable detached input, polynomial degree(null for zero), exact derivative, six levels h=1..1/32 each with three sample nodes/values, three complete differences/divisors/estimates/signedErrors/absoluteErrors/exact flags. Selected level identified by admitted denominator.
model.exactness: Forward/backward degree guarantee <=1, central <=2; actual exactness reported separately. No universal claim that central is always closer, error decreases on each finite refinement, or a zero sample slope proves constant function.
model.export: serializeDifferentiation accepts only actual admitted reports plus known inspectedMethod forward/backward/central; includes complete exact record and selected view. Copied or forged lookalikes refuse.

ui.inputs: Six coefficient inputs, point input and six explicit positive step choices; Calculate applies valid draft. Initial default example is explicit in labels.
ui.lifetime: Any mathematical input edit or preset selection retires rendered report and worked-record download immediately; a preset only fills the draft, then Calculate applies. Invalid calculation preserves draft and shows a field-appropriate error without a stale report.
ui.view: Forward/backward/central view selector changes only inspection of current report. Exact tables remain authoritative. Function/tangent/secant SVG uses approximate display coordinates; central secant passes through actual two endpoint samples, not falsely through f(x).
ui.visual: Desktop and390px, labeled keyboard controls, no page overflow; bounded horizontal table scroll where needed; figure explicitly approximate and not a measured physical plot.
ui.downloads: Explicit complete worked JSON, exact original twelve-question deck JSON and worked guide Markdown; actual downloaded deck admitted by unchanged learner, then actual learning/review/practice/notes receiving.
ui.effects: No arbitrary expression evaluation, browser storage, account, provider, network request, install or hosting.

content.review: Question-only masked file including all transfer prompts before keys/model exposure to independent reviewer; independent exact oracle before candidate access.
content.limits: Exact polynomial experiment isolates discretization error; it does not model floating-point rounding or noisy measured samples, choose a production optimal step, or establish learning efficacy.

receiving: Native unchanged original deck/model controls and absent new paths before implementation. New model invariants and independent exact arithmetic; actual standalone browser/download plus unchanged learner consumer; preserve failures and only replay affected boundaries.

ownership.github: All-state differentiation and finite-differences searches0; derivative search only closed Newton134. Complete2915-source tree lacks new paths and AGENTS.
ownership.native: 909 direct coordination JSON files; zero matching current selected metadata,36 permission refusals retained. No DB or global lease assertion.

policy: No Actions, PR/main/dispatch, service, installation, native Conscience append. Native source projection labeled separately from complete canonical metadata. Any later safe source custody needs a fresh full workflow guard.
